description: Run Tally the cat's bakery production line! Orders arrive for slices of cake and ribbon bars: cut wholes into equal parts, drag slices onto trays, re-slice pieces finer to make sizes match, compare shares and place finished shares on the number line. First Folds teaches halves, fourths and thirds; First Cuts, Re-Slice and Recipe Maths build fractions from unit shares to equivalence and adding slices, with the Jumble's silly orders (5/4 of a cake!) along the way. A making game, not a quiz: wrong cuts are shown on the tray, never punished.
notes: Built on the Oomba Kit 1.1.2 (pinned kit tag plus the art-props, art-animals, art-school and style-bold packs): Oomba.game with controls 'none' and a fixed camera, the kit's title, how-to, HUD (counter progress and star count), pause, results (w.win at chapter end), dialogs, toasts, settings, sounds, font and day/night palette. Tally the cat DEBUTS in this game (kit cat, scarf, peach/mint, CONFIG.tally) and guides every order from a speech panel with the game's own inline-SVG portrait of her; her course-media sprite is extracted from this game (scripts/csq-sprites.js KIT_CHARS 'tally'), never redrawn. The production line is the game's own DOM inside Oomba.ui.root(), below var(--ok-safe-top): SVG cakes (circle sectors) and bars (rectangles) the player cuts with slicer buttons (2, 3, 4, 6, 8) and fills by tapping parts, a number-line counter with tap targets, same-whole comparison trays and recipe source bars, every control at least 48 px with keyboard support on the parts. The first classic script is window.FractionFactory (the engine: seeded RNG, fraction helpers, goalOf, the Run with cut/tap/place/pick/serve actions — a wrong serve is counted, never a fail, and re-slicing rescales the taken parts proportionally — solve/play via advice(), the progress label and class quest number parsing); the second is window.FractionFactoryLevels (CHAPTERS folds/first-cuts/re-slice/recipe, LEVELS with intro/hints/check text, THEN chains per band). Chapters host Number Quest Explorer Unit 4 (The Bakery): First Cuts = 4.1 fraction meaning and the number line (3.NF.A.1/2), Re-Slice = 4.2 equivalence by re-cutting and same-whole comparing (3.NF.A.3, 4.NF.A.1/2), Recipe Maths = 4.3 adding slices with like and unlike denominators incl. the Jumble's 1/2 + 1/4 = 2/6 fault to fix (4.NF.B.3, 5.NF.A.1/2); First Folds is the Launchpad 6.3 preview (halves/fourths/thirds, no arithmetic). Lesson mode comes from BRB.params ({chapter, band, mode, level, lock}) or the 4-digit class quest number C B M L via __brbTest.code; lock=1 hides the counter map and band toggle and chains into the band's next chapter at chapter end. Progress: BRB.score.submit(starsInChapter, 'n/m orders, s stars[, c/k checks]') after every served order, BRB.gameOver({won: true, score}) ONLY at chapter completion (win-gated course credit), BRB.progress(detail) when the SDK has it. Save key fraction-factory-v1 in BRB.storage (band, best stars per level, skipped levels). Test hooks: __brbTest.start({chapter, band, mode, level, seed, lesson, lock}), state, act, advice, solve, hint, run, levels, chapters, code, closeCards, cover, skipAnimations. Modes: play, projector (bigger text, nothing saved). Words: English only in this build (FractionFactoryI18n is the empty pack table, the sibling games' pattern).
